content: Google Drive from a static SPA: use Google Identity Services (GIS) google.accounts.oauth2 token model (implicit-style) -- calls Drive REST v3 directly with CORS, no backend needed, no refresh tokens stored. Access tokens last ~1h; on expiry call requestAccessToken() again (silent re-auth possible). Use drive.file (non-sensitive, lighter verification) or appDataFolder scope. The Authorization-Code+PKCE refresh-token flow is impossible to keep secret in a pure static site, so the token model is the correct approach; limitation is periodic re-consent and 1h token lifetime. gapi.auth2 is deprecated; use GIS.
